{"id":1966381014,"question_id":3677,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1775098153,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1966381014/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Amount of Money Robot Can Earn","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int byrec(vector<vector<int>>& coins , int i , int j , int k)\n    {\n        int n = coins.size();\n        int m = coins[0].size();\n\n        if(i == n-1 and j == m-1) \n        {\n            if(coins[i][j] < 0 and k > 0) return max(0, coins[i][j]);\n            else return coins[i][j];\n        }\n\n        //going right\n        int right = INT_MIN;\n        if(j+1 < m)\n        {\n            if(coins[i][j] < 0 and k > 0) \n            {\n                int neutralize = 0 + byrec(coins , i , j+1 , k-1);\n                int dont_neutralize = coins[i][j] + byrec(coins , i , j+1 , k);\n                right = max(neutralize , dont_neutralize);\n            }\n            else right = coins[i][j] + byrec(coins , i , j+1 , k);\n        }\n\n        //going down\n        int down = INT_MIN;\n        if(i+1 < n)\n        {\n            if(coins[i][j] < 0 and k > 0) \n            {\n                int neutralize = 0 + byrec(coins , i+1 , j , k-1);\n                int dont_neutralize = coins[i][j] + byrec(coins , i+1 , j , k);\n                down = max(neutralize , dont_neutralize);\n            }\n            else down = coins[i][j] + byrec(coins , i+1 , j , k);\n        }\n\n        return max(right , down);\n    }\n\n    int maximumAmount(vector<vector<int>>& coins) {\n        return byrec(coins , 0 , 0 , 2);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-amount-of-money-robot-can-earn","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1896}
